text: Bear, sex can be what you do when you’re older and find a friend you love in a super special way that makes you want to raise children together. Don’t imagine you love each other just because you want each other. Don’t feel pressure to promise what your heart will feel. Let the love and bond it produces blossom genuinely as your hearts sync. Learn about each other before getting too close, and make sure to keep friends and community around who know both of you.
reader: someone reading an essay on romance for advice they can use in their own dating and relationships

sentences.s: Bear, sex can be what you do when you’re older and find a friend you love in a super special way that makes you want to raise children together.
sentences.payoff: they learn the author's view that sex belongs later, with a friend they love, and not as the first step.
sentences.follows: the heading 'Tough Love' sets up blunt advice, and this opens it by addressing someone as 'Bear'.
sentences.link: none: opens the section with an address

sentences.s: Don’t imagine you love each other just because you want each other.
sentences.payoff: they stop reading their desire for someone as proof of love.
sentences.follows: it states the mistake the first sentence's order of friendship, love, then sex avoids.

sentences.s: Don’t feel pressure to promise what your heart will feel.
sentences.payoff: they feel free not to promise love or a future before they feel it.
sentences.follows: it adds a second pressure to resist, one step on from mistaking desire for love.

sentences.s: Let the love and bond it produces blossom genuinely as your hearts sync.
sentences.payoff: they know to let the love and bond come for real, not to fake or force a feeling they don't have yet.
sentences.follows: it turns from what not to do (S3, promising what your heart will feel) to what to allow instead.

sentences.s: Learn about each other before getting too close, and make sure to keep friends and community around who know both of you.
sentences.payoff: they have two things to do: learn about the person first and keep friends and community around who know both of them.
sentences.follows: it gives the practical steps that let love grow for real (S4): learn about the person first, and keep people around who know you both.

placement: It sits under 'Tough Love' as direct advice to a young person about sex and love, so the reader gets the blunt version before it is softened.
